title: Prenatal diagnosis of a 22q11.2 deletion in a fetus with tetralogy of Fallot: a case report
abstract: We report a 28-year-old gravida 2 woman whose fetus showed tetralogy of Fallot and increased nuchal translucency on ultrasound at 13 weeks. Amniocentesis was performed; karyotyping was normal but chromosomal microarray revealed a 2.5 Mb deletion at 22q11.2. The pregnancy was terminated.

title: Whole exome sequencing in fetuses with ultrasound anomalies: a retrospective cohort
abstract: We retrospectively analysed 120 fetuses with structural anomalies on prenatal ultrasound, including ventriculomegaly and skeletal dysplasia. Trio whole exome sequencing identified pathogenic variants in 28 fetuses, confirmed by Sanger sequencing.

title: Prenatal diagnosis of chromosomal abnormalities: a systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract: We reviewed studies of fetal ultrasound anomalies tested by karyotyping and microarray.

title: Knockout mouse model of ventriculomegaly
abstract: Mice lacking gene X develop ventriculomegaly. Sanger sequencing and PCR genotyping confirmed the deletion.

title: Performance of cell-free DNA screening for trisomy 21 in a general population
abstract: Sensitivity and specificity of NIPT were evaluated in 20,000 pregnancies.

title: A novel de novo variant in a fetus with cystic hygroma and hydrops
abstract: A fetus presented with cystic hygroma and hydrops fetalis on ultrasound. Parental consent was obtained for genetic analysis.

title: Mitochondrial DNA variants in adults with diabetes
abstract: We sequenced mtDNA in 300 adult patients with diabetes.
